content:
maria: Heads-up: getting several tickets about intermittent 413s on embeddings when customers send mixed-length arrays (some 512-d vectors + a single 12288-d vector). Thought we had stable payload limits? :confused:

nina: that's the splitter/route decision edge. when splitter tries to chunk, we hit `max_payload_bytes` on certain shards and return 413. client sees it as random because routing varies.

oliver: example request shape: `[{text:... dims=512}, {text:... dims=512}, {text:... dims=12288}]` — server used per-shard byte budget and threw 413 after partial processing.

dmitri: ugly. two problems: 1) customers don't understand why their mixed-dim batch fails, 2) telemetry doesn't make it easy to find offending items. We need preflight and clearer error payloads.

sre-oncall: agree. propose a preflight endpoint `/v1/embeddings:preflight` that returns estimated routing, estimated unit cost, and explains if a request will be split/413. Metric names: `embeds.preflight.calls`, `embeds.preflight.estimate_units`, `embeds.413_reasons` (enum: shard_budget, dims_exceed_limit, unknown).

zara: console UX idea: when a request fails with 413, show the original payload preview + preflight advice link. Add a small CTA: "Run preflight to get unit estimate and suggested split plan." Also show a heatmap of tenants hitting 413s by reason.

maria: agree. preflight should be cheap and idempotent (no compute heavy work). return: `estimated_units`, `will_split:bool`, `split_plan: [chunk_sizes]`, `recommended_header: X-Embed-Split: auto|prefer-client` (clients can opt-in). Keep response terse.

nina: also add `preflight_rejects` telemetry for requests where preflight says will fail. we can surface in console and auto-suggest SDK changes.

oliver: pseudocode for router preflight: ```
function preflight(payload){
  total_bytes = sum(estimate_bytes(v) for v in payload)
  if (any(dim > server_max_dim)) return {error: 'dims_exceed_limit'}
  if (total_bytes <= shard_budget) return {estimated_units: units_for(total_bytes), will_split:false}
  plan = compute_split_plan(payload, shard_budget)
  if (plan.unresolvable) return {error:'shard_budget'}
  return {estimated_units: units_for(plan.total_bytes), will_split:true, split_plan: plan.chunks}
}
```

dmitri: we should expose `units_estimate` in both preflight and error responses so customers can see billing impact. Also add `X-Embed-Estimate` header in responses for quick SDK display.

sre-oncall: alerting: add a dashboard with `413_rate_by_reason` and color-coded thresholds. Alert if tenant 413 rate > 1% and `413_shard_budget` reason > 50% of tenant 413s for 15m. Also add a trend line for `preflight_usage` to ensure preflight reduces 413s.

zara: console card mock: top line shows 413 count and percent change, then a split donut by reason, then sample failing payload (sanitized), and a "Run preflight" button that calls API with last payload snapshot. Also include a per-tenant recommended SDK snippet to auto-split.

maria: SDK change: add `client_side_splitter` option (default off). When enabled, SDK runs local preflight and splits payload before sending. Add opt-in header `X-Embed-Split: client` to indicate server can skip splitter. This will reduce server churn.

nina: careful: client-side splitting changes accounting semantics slightly. we need `units_estimate_client` telemetry to compare to server estimates. Add `client_split_delta_pct` metric.

dmitri: we'll need to version preflight output, include `preflight.v=1` to allow future fields. Also log `preflight_id` in traces so we can correlate the failing request with preflight run.

sre-oncall: on rollout: 1) implement preflight endpoint (internal canary), 2) add console card hooked to metrics, 3) SDK client splitter opt-in, 4) run canary for 72h and monitor `413_rate_by_reason` and `client_split_delta_pct`. Page if `413_rate` increases or `client_split_delta_pct` > 15% and rising.

zara: timeline: I can ship a console mock tomorrow and wire to a staging metric stream. Need final metric names.

maria: metric names proposal: `embeds.preflight.calls`, `embeds.preflight.estimate_units`, `embeds.preflight.errors`, `embeds.413.rate`, `embeds.413.by_reason`, `embeds.client_split.delta_pct`. ok?

sre-oncall: ack. i'll add alert rules once names are final.

oliver: small UX/behavior note: preflight should allow a `fast=true` param that returns only high-level result (will_split, estimate) to keep it cheap for SDKs that call it automatically. Full `detail=true` returns split_plan and chunk sizes.

dmitri: good call. also add header `X-Preflight-Cache: ttl=60s` to allow caching of repeated identical requests. saves load.

ops-bot: feature flag pipeline created: `embeds.preflight` -> canary 5% -> will report canary metrics here. :rocket:

zara: assigning action items: nina - preflight API + trace ids, oliver - SDK client-split PR, dmitri - error payload standardization + headers, sre-oncall - metrics + alerts, zara - console mock. reconvene after 72h canary. :thumbsup:
